title: Behind the scenes: the portal can now hide a company from a member
text: Nothing to see on screen yet. The client portal, its chat, its notices and the Storage app now leave out a company when the person's link to it carries a "no portal access" mark, while the person stays an owner everywhere else (Operating Agreement, SS-4, ownership list). Nobody has the mark today, so nothing changes for any client. This is the first part of the per-member portal access tick for multi-member companies; the tick itself and the team buttons come next and stay switched off until we have tested the whole thing.
